title: The Mirror Words Adventure
moral: Trying carefully and thinking helps solve problems.

scenes.summary: Mia discovers a secret mirror word challenge.
scenes.text: Mia found a note that could only be read using a mirror and started her fun puzzle adventure.

story: Mia found a secret note that could be read using a mirror. She worked hard to understand the letters and followed clues around her house. Along the way, she helped tidy things and solved puzzles. At the end, she read the final message 'YOU CAN' and felt proud. Her family celebrated her success, and she learned that trying and thinking carefully helps solve problems.
